name: calc-readiness
description: Calculus-readiness city-builder. Monorepo: three engine lanes over frozen shared packages. See README.md and docs/.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @cr/web
scripts.test:era8-10-manifest: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/generateEra8To10AssetManifest.test.ts --testTimeout=30000 && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts apps/web/src/city/era8To10AssetManifest.browser.test.tsx --testTimeout=30000
scripts.local:test: npm run local:test:unit && npm run local:test:browser && npm run check:graph && npm run check:lessons
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser && npm run check:graph && npm run check:lessons
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:era7-models && npm run check:era8-10-models && npm test
scripts.local:check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:era7-models && npm run check:era8-10-models && npm run local:test
scripts.release:check: npm run local:check && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high
